blockingFindings.title: Missing persisted-state atomicity coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 and R5 explicitly require persisted step state and durable artifacts/logs to remain unchanged across failure boundaries; current tests can pass while production writes partial state to disk.
blockingFindings.issue: The tests only compare the in-memory `state` object and a mock transition list after pre-commit failures. They do not create or snapshot `flow.json`, persisted step state, issue-log, findings, or existing gate artifacts, so they cannot verify the byte-identical persisted rollback requirement.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local coverage that initializes persisted flow/gate state, snapshots the relevant files before each injected failure, and asserts those persisted files remain byte-identical after the failed attempt and before retry.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 and R5 explicitly require persisted step state and durable artifacts/logs to remain unchanged across failure boundaries; current tests can pass while production writes partial state to disk.

blockingFindings.title: Transition-count assertion encodes an incomplete lifecycle premise
blockingFindings.rationale: This test can force or accept an implementation that records stale recovery as an implicit side effect or skips one lifecycle update, contradicting R4.
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 test expects `commit:1` and `manager.transitions.length === 1` while also requiring stale-step recovery to be recorded as an explicit transition. With both a stale gate step and a selected gate owner present, a single transition cannot demonstrate both selected gate commit and explicit stale-step recovery.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Adjust the R4 test to assert the actual required transition semantics: selected gate ownership commits once and stale-step recovery is represented explicitly, without collapsing both effects into one ambiguous transition count.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This test can force or accept an implementation that records stale recovery as an implicit side effect or skips one lifecycle update, contradicting R4.

blockingFindings.title: R1 side-effect surface is under-tested
blockingFindings.rationale: R1’s acceptance surface includes multiple persisted side-effect channels; current coverage can pass even if inference writes diagnostics, artifacts, findings, or flow state.
blockingFindings.issue: The R1 test verifies only that `resolveGatePhaseFromState` and transition construction do not mutate the local state object. It does not cover the required absence of mutations to `flow.json`, issue-log, findings, gate artifacts, or committed-transition diagnostics.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local test that runs phase inference in a fixture with those persisted surfaces present and asserts no file/content changes and no committed-transition diagnostics are produced.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R1’s acceptance surface includes multiple persisted side-effect channels; current coverage can pass even if inference writes diagnostics, artifacts, findings, or flow state.
